title: AMBER PMEMD Molecular Dynamics
description: GPU-accelerated molecular dynamics simulation using AMBER PMEMD with GAFF2 ligand parameterisation and MM-GBSA binding free energy calculation.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

receptor.description: Receptor PDB file or S3 URI (protein structure).

force_field.description: AMBER protein force field. ff19SB is recommended for modern MD (2019+); ff14SB is the previous standard.
force_field.help_text: ff19SB (Tian et al., 2020, JCTC) supersedes ff14SB for most protein simulations.

water_model.description: Explicit water model. TIP3P is fast and widely used; OPC is more accurate for thermodynamic properties.
water_model.help_text: OPC (Izadi et al., 2014) gives better solvation free energies but is ~30% slower.

gaff_version.description: GAFF ligand force field version. gaff2 is preferred for new projects.
gaff_version.help_text: GAFF2 (Wang et al., 2004 extended) improves torsion parameters for drug-like molecules.

box_padding.description: Distance (Å) from protein surface to simulation box edge. 12 Å is standard.

n_steps.description: Number of MD steps. At dt=0.002 ps, 5,000,000 steps = 10 ns.

dt.description: Integration timestep in picoseconds. 2 fs is the standard for H-bond constrained systems.

temperature.description: Simulation temperature in Kelvin. 300 K (27°C) is physiological standard.

pressure.description: Pressure in atm for NPT ensemble. 1.0 atm = standard conditions.

mmgbsa_startframe.description: Skip first N trajectory frames for MM-GBSA (equilibration buffer). 500 frames = first 1 ns.

mmgbsa_interval.description: Analyse every Nth frame for MM-GBSA to control cost.

gpu.description: Enable GPU acceleration. Strongly recommended — GPU runs ~100× faster than CPU for production MD.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
